name: Can older home renovations improve energy efficiency?

mainEntity.name: Can older home renovations improve energy efficiency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. Older home renovations are an excellent opportunity to significantly improve energy efficiency. Upgrades can include installing new, energy-efficient windows and doors, adding insulation to walls, attics, and crawl spaces, and replacing outdated HVAC systems with modern, high-efficiency units. Sealing air leaks and upgrading appliances can also contribute to substantial energy savings. These improvements not only reduce utility bills but also enhance indoor comfort and contribute to a more sustainable home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, older home renovations can greatly improve energy efficiency. Upgrades like new windows, insulation, and efficient HVAC systems reduce utility bills and enhance comfort.
